exposure: timing of adenomyomectomy within the menstrual cycle (secretory phase vs. proliferative phase)
cohort: The study included 143 patients with histologically confirmed adenomyosis who underwent uterus-sparing adenomyomectomy between January 2021 and April 2024.
finding: Adenomyomectomy performed during the secretory phase of the menstrual cycle is associated with significantly lower recurrence rates and improved long-term outcomes compared to surgery during the proliferative phase.
followup_time: Up to 48.70 months (median recurrence-free survival of 45.19 months in the secretory phase group and 34.40 months in the proliferative phase group).
